reviewStandard: Clinical-caution pages may not receive generic warning graphics, crossed-out products, stigmatizing patient imagery, condition anatomy used as treatment evidence, or elemental-metal media substituted for a clinical product. All six routes fail before prompt creation.
promotionRule: No Batch 118 source hash exists or is eligible for promotion. All six routes remain asset-free scientific holds. No generated source, master, derivative, registry record, endpoint, Schema object, social preview, or image-sitemap entry may be created from this batch.

routeDecisions.reason: The page explicitly exempts true pediatric iron deficiency and labels its proposal a mechanistic hypothesis. Its four autism and microbiome sources do not establish a clinical iron-withholding protocol or define hepcidin testing, deficiency or anemia, formulation, route, dose, age, diet, comorbidity, monitoring, outcomes, safety, or exceptions. Child, brain, gut, blood, tablet, iron, or prohibition imagery would be stigmatizing or clinically misleading.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Add direct pediatric clinical evidence and guidance; define autism population, deficiency and anemia criteria, hepcidin assay and threshold, formulation, route, elemental dose, schedule, diet, comorbidities, comparator, monitoring, developmental and hematologic outcomes, adverse events, and exceptions.
